_source.library: crewai 1.15.44 (Python < 3.14; its own venv: crewai pins openai < 3)
_source.grounding: Crew(agents=[Agent], tasks=[Task]).kickoff() with a BaseLLM subclass returning a fixed final answer, CrewAI telemetry and tracing off.
_source.recorded: 2026-11-19, offline (mocked transport, no network, no real keys), by sdk/python/tests/test_instrument.py with SUPERBASED_RECORD_FIXTURES=1

_gaps: The agent span has no agent name key: the role is only in graph.node.id, which genaiattr reads as the agent name of an AGENT span since genaiattr-3 (lane LF-4). There is one agent span per task (Task._execute_core), no separate task span.
No LLM span: the CrewAI instrumentor covers crew, task and agent; the model call is captured by the openai (or litellm) instrumentation when that is on.
crew_inputs, crew_tasks and crew_agents carry content genaiattr does not map; masked as extra content.
